Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Anil - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aditya: "What lovely weather!"

[Aditya bursts out laughing.]

Aditya: "Mom, listen!"

[Aditya starts crying.]

Aditya: "That's great!"

[Aditya smiles at Mother.]

Aditya (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditya stamps his foot in anger.]

Pallavi: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya gets frightened and steps back.]

Pallavi: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Pallavi: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya plays with his dog.]

Aditya (gently): "What a day to remember!"
